task.title: Modifying the QuayRegistry CR by using the OpenShift Container Platform web console
task.shortdesc: To modify the QuayRegistry custom resource in Red Hat Quay, you can use the OpenShift Container Platform web console to change component management settings. You can set managed components to unmanaged and use your own infrastructure.

ul.li: You are logged into OpenShift Container Platform as a user with admin privileges.
You have installed the Red Hat Quay Operator.

step.cmd: On the OpenShift Container Platform web console, click Operators → Installed Operators.
Click the name of your Red Hat Quay registry, for example, example-registry.
Adjust the managed field of the desired component to either True or False.

note.p: Setting a component to unmanaged (managed: false) might require additional configuration. For more information about setting unmanaged components in the QuayRegistry CR, see Using unmanaged components for dependencies.
